text:
cheng: FYI — follow-up from last night's postmortem on the cross-region retry spike. Observed repeated backend ejections + TLS handshake resets between us-east and eu-west around 02:10-02:40 UTC. Need remediation owners + timelines.

maria: thanks. do we have a concise RCA summary we can paste for execs? short bullet points ok.

cheng: sure — short version:
- intermittent backend healthcheck failures triggered ejects
- some clients hit TLS handshake_failure (fatal alert 40) during fallback to alternate backend
- pattern appears when route selection moves traffic across region boundary under load
- potential SNI header mangling or ALPN mismatch on the proxy -> causes some resets

sam: can we confirm if this is new after the routing tweak last week (172f2b3)?

jordan: I ran a quick compare of the traffic distribution. The tweak increased inter-region burst by ~18% during peak, which aligns w/ timing. pushing to ops notes.

priya: assigning initial remediation candidates:
- short-term: tune healthcheck grace period + lower eject threshold (owner: sam)
- medium: add TLS handshake metric and alert (owner: maria)
- long-term: verify upstream proxy ALPN/SNI pass-through and add integration test (owner: cheng)
Can owners confirm ETA?

sam: short-term changes I'm OK to roll. ETA: config change in 2 hours, monitor for 24h. I'll post the CLI diff.

maria: medium-term alert — I can have alert + dashboard in 1 day. will include a synthetic handshake probe across regions.

cheng: long-term perf/integration test — need infra support. ETA 2 weeks for a test harness + 1 more week for rollout. tagging infra team next.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: sam will apply lb-config v2026.03.23-ops at 2026-03-23T10:45:00Z :rocket:

sam: applying now, will watch for any immediate regressions. commands used:
```
rlbctl apply --change-file lb-eject-tweak.yml --target edge-lb-pool
kubectl annotate deployment edge-proxy rollout=manual
```

maria: once the alert is live, can we set a pager policy to page @network-oncall only for >5% handshake_failure across 5m window? else slack notify.

cheng: agreed. also adding an action: update the postmortem doc with the new owners + timelines (I'll edit the doc). priya, can you own the postmortem updates?

priya: yep, I'll update the doc and add a quick checklist. Also will add a recurring item to the monthly incident review to look for SNI/ALPN regressions.

sam: preliminary results after config change: eject rate down ~60% in the last 30m. still see a few handshake_failure spikes but much less frequent. continuing to monitor.

jordan: archived the capture from 02:15 window to gs://redwood-ops/incident-captures/2090012345/ for deeper offline analysis.

cheng: thanks all — next check-ins:
- sam to report by 2090015600 (2h) on stability after config change
- maria to post dashboard link by 2090100000 (1d)
- cheng/infra to scope integration test by 2091200000 (2w)
If anything regresses, reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
